company.name: LCC Bathrooms & Services
company.tagline: Bathroom fitters in London, from strip-out to the last bead of silicone.
company.heroSupport: Bathroom renovations for homes across London, including Barnes, Richmond and Tooting. One accountable team, from strip-out to the final coat of paint.
company.statement: LCC Bathrooms & Services is a family-run bathroom company with more than 30 years in the trade, in London and before that in Spain. We are a team of four: the same people strip out, re-pipe, tile and finish every room, so you have one point of contact from the first visit to the final clean. Our team holds NVQ Level 2 Plumbing, CSCS cards, asbestos awareness, first aid and fire marshal training.
